authority: owner directive 2026-10-13, section 7 B3 (diagnose the capitals regression with controlled development comparisons)
question: Why did the v1.2 pilot candidate answer country/US-state capitals worse than the base's few-shot answers?
observation_motivating: test-split exploratory analysis (already reported, not reused for decisions): 26 of 49 wrong candidate capital answers are training-split capital labels

hypotheses.H1: label capture: supervised bare-label fact targets (facts.* plus facts embedded in hierarchy/user-format items; 2,887 VERIFIED_SOURCE train episodes) teach the model to answer with training labels
hypotheses.H2: general drift: instruction SFT degrades recall regardless of fact data
hypotheses.H3: elicitation: knowledge is intact but the chat format elicits it worse than few-shot prompting

split: dev only (bundle f9632015 dev chat facts items; few-shot prompts built from train-split shots of the same relation, as the builder builds test few-shot prompts). The test split is not used.

models.arm_nofacts: 300 updates on j1-sft-v1.2-diag-nofacts (7f5a31aa: every facts.* and VERIFIED_SOURCE train episode removed)

arms.contract: pilot recipe of protocol v3 except: total_updates 300, warmup 15, min_lr_ratio 1.0 (constant after warmup), dev_every 300; seed 1; lr 3e-5
arms.identity: the two arms differ only in the dataset manifest; both are diagnostic (never candidates)

metrics: accuracy per relation and overall on dev facts, chat (strict) and few-shot
capture rate: wrong answers equal to a training-split label of the same relation / wrong answers
abstention rate on dev facts (false abstention)

interpretation.H1_supported_if: arm_full capture rate exceeds arm_nofacts capture rate by >= 0.15 AND arm_nofacts chat accuracy on capitals (country+US state) >= arm_full's
interpretation.H2_supported_if: few-shot accuracy of arm_nofacts or pilot_s1_final is below the base's by >= 3 items overall
interpretation.H3_supported_if: pilot_s1_final few-shot accuracy is within 2 items of the base few-shot while its chat accuracy is lower by >= 3 items
interpretation.n_caveat: about 85 dev items (24 capitals): descriptive and exploratory; hypotheses are not mutually exclusive; no significance claim

use: chooses the v1.3 fact-target framing and mixture (dataset v1.3 B3) before any v1.3 training; recorded with all arm outputs
